description: This file defines the QueryBuilder interface for constructing query objects with options such as sorting, limiting, size, and skipping elements. It is a key part of a query DSL in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: QueryBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining the builder pattern for creating Query objects, including methods to set sorting options, limits, size, skipping, and building the final Query.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sets sorting options for the query, overwriting any existing sort options.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of elements to return in the query results.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Sets the size constraint, similar to limit, for the number of elements returned.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Specifies the number of elements to skip at the beginning of the query results.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the final Query object based on the specified parameters.
